title: California's 27th Congressional District general election, 2026
description: California's 27th Congressional District election pits freshman Democratic incumbent George Whitesides against Republican challenger and Santa Clarita City Councilmember Jason Gibbs. The district, which covers northern Los Angeles County including Santa Clarita, Palmdale, Lancaster, and parts of the northwestern San Fernando Valley, was redrawn under Proposition 50, making it more Democratic-leaning after losing conservative areas and gaining more Democratic voters. Whitesides narrowly flipped the seat in 2024 by defeating Republican Mike Garcia, and nonpartisan analysts rate the race as Lean Democratic under the new map. Key contrasts include the candidates' views on economic policy, immigration, and the Trump administration's agenda.
polling_note: No independent general-election opinion polls with published sample sizes and percentages were found for this race. Prediction markets reflect general-election odds but are not included as traditional polling.

candidates.name: George Whitesides
candidates.summary: George Whitesides is the incumbent Democratic U.S. Representative for California's 27th Congressional District, first elected in 2024. He previously served as NASA Chief of Staff during the Obama administration and was the first CEO of Virgin Galactic, where he created hundreds of aerospace jobs in the Antelope Valley. Whitesides co-founded Megafire Action, a nonprofit focused on wildfire prevention legislation, and serves on the House Armed Services and Science, Space, and Technology committees.

candidates.name: Jason Gibbs
candidates.summary: Jason Gibbs is a Republican candidate for U.S. House in California's 27th Congressional District and a Santa Clarita City Councilmember first elected in 2020, serving as mayor in 2023. He holds bachelor's and master's degrees in mechanical engineering from Cal Poly San Luis Obispo and worked in the aerospace industry on rocket launch systems including Delta II, Delta IV, and Atlas V. Gibbs emphasizes fiscal responsibility, public safety, border security, and local control in his campaign, and has served on the boards of the Boys and Girls Club, Valley Industry Association, and Salvation Army.
